user.title: Create a virtual gate
user.description: Set the gate identity and physical controller layout.

data_description.name: A descriptive name, for example Driveway Gate.
data_description.control_mode: How the physical controller exposes OPEN, CLOSE, and optional STOP controls.

controls.title: Control sources
controls.description: Select the existing switch or button entities that operate this gate.

data_description.step_source: The single control used by a step-by-step controller.
data_description.stop_source: The dedicated control that stops movement.

limits.title: Endpoint and safety sensors
limits.description: Endpoint sensors are optional. Their physical state takes precedence over time estimates.

data_description.open_limit: Optional binary sensor active at the fully open endpoint.
data_description.open_limit_debounce_ms: How long the state must remain stable.
data_description.closed_limit: Optional binary sensor active at the fully closed endpoint.
data_description.closed_limit_debounce_ms: How long the state must remain stable.
data_description.obstacle_source: Optional binary sensor that blocks CLOSE while active.

timing.title: Travel timing
timing.description: Configure opening and closing independently. A configured endpoint sensor must still confirm arrival.

data_description.opening_time_ms: Expected travel time from CLOSED to OPEN.
data_description.closing_time_ms: Expected travel time from OPEN to CLOSED.
data_description.opening_margin_ms: Extra time before reporting an opening timeout.
data_description.closing_margin_ms: Extra time before reporting a closing timeout.

advanced.title: Command behavior
advanced.description: Choose only behavior supported by the physical controller. Safe defaults ignore STOP, reversal, and repeated commands.

data_description.pulse_duration_ms: Time a switch remains active for a pulse.
data_description.hold_duration_ms: Time a switch remains active for a bounded HOLD.
data_description.minimum_command_interval_ms: Minimum time between physical command sequences.
data_description.pulse_interval_ms: Wait between steps in a multi-pulse strategy.
data_description.pulse_count: Number of pulses in a multi-pulse strategy.
data_description.stop_strategy: How motion is stopped. Unsupported means STOP is not exposed.
data_description.direction_change_strategy: How a moving gate reverses direction.
data_description.repeated_open_policy: Behavior for OPEN while already open or opening.
data_description.repeated_close_policy: Behavior for CLOSE while already closed or closing.

error.duplicate_control_source: OPEN, CLOSE, and STOP controls must use different entities.
error.duplicate_sensor: Endpoint and obstacle roles must use different sensors.
error.invalid_source_layout: The selected controls do not match the control mode.
error.positive: Enter a value greater than zero.
error.non_negative: Enter zero or a positive value.
error.unsupported_version: This configuration version is not supported.
error.custom_sequence_not_supported: Custom sequences are not supported in the MVP.
error.dedicated_stop_required: Dedicated STOP requires a dedicated STOP control.
error.hold_requires_switch: A HOLD strategy requires switch controls.
error.direct_requires_separate_controls: Direct reversal requires separate OPEN and CLOSE controls.
error.reversal_requires_stop: This reversal strategy requires a configured STOP strategy.
error.multi_pulse_requires_multiple: A multi-pulse strategy requires at least two pulses.
error.repeated_stop_requires_stop: The repeated-command STOP policy requires a configured STOP strategy.

abort.duplicate_gate: A virtual gate already uses this set of control entities.

stop_unsupported.message: STOP is not configured for this gate.

controller_unloaded.message: The virtual gate is unloading and cannot accept commands.

source_unavailable.message: A required gate control is unavailable.

limit_sensor_conflict.message: Both endpoint sensors are active. Movement is blocked.

obstacle_active.message: Closing is blocked because the obstacle sensor is active.

direction_unknown.message: The movement direction is unknown, so this STOP strategy cannot be used safely.
